_doc: Per-office-type election windows for school-board (and later municipal) race views. A finance row (contribution or IE) is bucketed to an election by its FILING DATE falling in [start, end] inclusive; start:null means open-ended into the past. The SBE 'cycle' field is the useless 4-year bucket (Diagnostic B) and is NOT used here -- bucket by date only. Ordered most-recent-last within each office_type. Extensible: add a 'municipal' key with its own ordered list when that calendar fills in.
